description: This file defines the RetrieveSubjectResponse class, which represents the response to a RetrieveSubject command in a policy management system. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, retrieving entity data, and managing response metadata.

classes.name: RetrieveSubjectResponse
classes.description: Immutable class representing the response to a RetrieveSubject command, encapsulating policy ID, label, subject ID, subject object, and response metadata. Includes factory methods for creation and JSON serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of RetrieveSubjectResponse with explicit policy ID, label, subject ID, subject JSON object, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string or object into a RetrieveSubjectResponse instance, extracting metadata and subject data.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the policy ID associated with this response.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the retrieved policy entry.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the Subject object constructed from stored data.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the given JSON entity replaced.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Updates the response with new headers.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the resource represented by this response.
